"To say that the defence investment plan is a whole load of smoke and mirrors is the understatement of the century."

Europe is getting "fed up" of the UK claiming to be a leader in Nato but unable to commit to defence spending, so the £5 billion hole in the defence investment plan may push them over the edge, says editor of defence analysis, Francis Tusa.

Francis Tusa was speaking to Kate McCann and Stig Abell on Times Radio Breakfast. Listen live every Monday-Thursday, 6-10am.
